You can ask for anything - explainers, visualizers, dashboards, bespoke single-use apps (e.g. a full wandb that is hyper-specific just for your project), you can 10X your test suite, auto-optimize code, run giant research projects with custom HTML for the results, anything! The broader takeaway is that it turns a narrow update into something readers can reuse when thinking about tools, systems, and tradeoffs in AI work. items.title_zh: 不存在的社区
items.summary_en: There is a strange thing that happens in communities that gather around abstinence from something: identity from opposition. At their best these communities are not just negative: childfree spaces can be about autonomy, choice and acceptance, anti-car spaces about safer streets and transit, and LLM-skeptical developer spaces about the future of labor, code quality and slop 1 . But the thing being refused often does not go away and instead becomes the main subject of the community’s identity. The broader takeaway is that it turns a narrow update into something readers can reuse when thinking about tools, systems, and tradeoffs in AI work. For the digest, Communities of Not stands out because it offers enough concrete detail to be useful, while also surfacing the tradeoffs that matter when people evaluate tools, models, and implementation decisions.

items.title_en: What do coders do after AI?
items.title_zh: AI 之后编码员做什么？
items.summary_en: For the New York Times Magazine this Sunday, I talked to Clive Thompson about one of the conversations that I'm having most often these days: What happens to coders in this current moment of extraordinarily rapid evolution in AI? LLMs are now quickly advancing to where they can virtually become entire software factories, radically changing both the economics and the power dynamics of software creation — which has so far mostly been used to displace massive numbers of tech workers. What makes it notable is the way it connects agent design decisions to practical reliability, tool use, and developer ergonomics. For the digest, What do coders do after AI? stands out because it offers enough concrete detail to be useful, while also surfacing the tradeoffs that matter when people evaluate tools, models, and implementation decisions.
